title: scVI deep learning uncovers markers of double negative T cell subsets
summary: Single Cell Variational Inference (scVI) applied to splenic double negative T cell scRNA-seq data predicted markers that flow cytometry confirmed. CD137 marked activated rather than naive DNT cells, CD30 and CD153 marked activated DNT cells, Ly49G2 marked a naive subgroup, and MHC-II expression was found on a subset of human DNT cells.
ai_technology: Single Cell Variational Inference (scVI) deep generative model on scRNA-seq data

evidence.tested: Flow cytometry confirmation in C57BL/6 and MRL/lpr mice and in human DNT cells.
evidence.unknown: Mouse spleen; human confirmation limited to MHC-II; scVI is a standard tool; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: scVI-based analysis predicted the DNT subgroup markers.
